#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Process-only acceptance harness; application behavior lives in Marimay."""
import json
import os
from pathlib import Path
import subprocess
import tempfile
import time

from measure import dataset
from mmay_acceptance import Application


ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
HARNESS = Application(ROOT)
MMAY = HARNESS.compiler
invoke = HARNESS.run
successful = HARNESS.successful


def main():
    build = ROOT / "build"
    build.mkdir(exist_ok=True)
    source = (ROOT / "fixtures/v1.json").read_bytes()
    expected = (ROOT / "fixtures/v2.json").read_bytes().removesuffix(b"\n")
    start = time.monotonic()
    with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix="acceptance-", dir=build) as directory:
        work = Path(directory)
        grants = ["--allow-read", str(ROOT), "--allow-write", str(work)]
        engines = HARNESS.engines(work, "config", grants)
        harness_metadata = HARNESS.metadata(engines)
        output = work / "output.json"
        cases = [
            (["--help"], None, 0),
            ([], None, 2),
            (["wrong", "-"], b"", 2),
            (["validate", "-", "--output", str(output)], source, 2),
            (["migrate", "-", "--in-place"], source, 2),
            (["migrate", "-", "--json"], source, 2),
            (["validate", "-", "--max-bytes", "0"], source, 2),
            (["validate", "-", "--max-bytes", "NaN"], source, 2),
            (["validate", "-", "--json"], source, 0),
            (["validate", "fixtures/v2.json"], None, 0),
            (["validate", "-", "--max-bytes", str(len(source))], source, 0),
            (["validate", "-", "--max-bytes", str(len(source) - 1)], source, 1),
            (["validate", str(work / "missing.json")], None, 1),
            (["migrate", "-"], source, 0),
            (["migrate", "-"], expected, 0),
        ]
        malformed = [
            b"", b"{}", b"null", b"\xff", b'{"version":3}',
            b'{"version":1,"version":1}', source + b"{}",
            b'{"version":2,"project":{"name":false}}',
            b'{"version":1,"extra":null}',
            source.replace(b'".json"', b'".my"'),
            source.replace(b'"maxFileBytes":1024', b'"maxFileBytes":0'),
        ]
        cases += [(["validate", "-", "--json"], data, 1) for data in malformed]
        large = json.loads(expected)
        large["scan"]["requiredFiles"] = [f"dir/file-{i}.my" for i in range(1000)]
        large_bytes = json.dumps(large, ensure_ascii=False).encode()
        cases.append((["validate", "-", "--json"], large_bytes, 0))
        near_limit = dataset(43680)
        assert len(near_limit) == 1048459
        at_limit = near_limit + b" " * (1048576 - len(near_limit))
        cases += [
            (["validate", "-", "--json"], near_limit, 0),
            (["validate", "-", "--json"], dataset(43680, True), 0),
            (["validate", "-", "--json"], at_limit, 0),
            (["validate", "-", "--json"], at_limit + b" ", 1),
            (["validate", "-", "--json"], near_limit[:-1] + b"!", 1),
        ]
        for number, (arguments, data, status) in enumerate(cases):
            def verify_case(engine, result):
                actual = (result.returncode, result.stdout, result.stderr)
                assert not (result.stderr if status == 0 else result.stdout), (number, engine, actual)
                if "--json" in arguments and status != 2:
                    report = json.loads(result.stdout if status == 0 else result.stderr)
                    assert report["ok"] == (status == 0)
                    assert isinstance(report["location"], str)
                if arguments == ["migrate", "-"]:
                    assert result.stdout == expected
            HARNESS.compare(engines, arguments, status, data=data,
                            label=number, verify=verify_case)
        for engine, prefix in engines.items():
            output.write_bytes(b"original")
            result = invoke([*prefix, "migrate", "-", "--output", str(output), "--json"], input=source)
            assert result.returncode == 0 and not result.stderr, (engine, result)
            assert json.loads(result.stdout)["ok"] and output.read_bytes() == expected
            for bad_input, extra in ((b"{}", []), (source, ["--max-bytes", str(len(source))])):
                output.write_bytes(b"original")
                result = invoke([*prefix, "migrate", "-", "--output", str(output), *extra], input=bad_input)
                assert result.returncode == 1 and output.read_bytes() == b"original", (engine, result)
            output.write_bytes(source)
            result = invoke([*prefix, "migrate", str(output), "--in-place"])
            assert result.returncode == 0 and output.read_bytes() == expected, (engine, result)
            output.write_bytes(b"{}")
            result = invoke([*prefix, "migrate", str(output), "--in-place"])
            assert result.returncode == 1 and output.read_bytes() == b"{}", (engine, result)
            result = invoke([*prefix, "migrate", "-", "--output", str(work / "absent/out.json")], input=source)
            assert result.returncode == 1 and not (work / "absent").exists(), (engine, result)
            read_fd, write_fd = os.pipe()
            os.close(read_fd)
            try:
                child = subprocess.Popen([*prefix, "migrate", "-"], cwd=ROOT,
                    stdin=subprocess.PIPE, stdout=write_fd, stderr=subprocess.PIPE)
            finally:
                os.close(write_fd)
            _, error = child.communicate(source, timeout=120)
            assert child.returncode == 1 and error, (engine, child.returncode, error)
        denied = work / "config-denied"
        successful([MMAY, "build", ".", "--release", "--output", str(denied)])
        for prefix in ([MMAY, "run", ".", "--"], [str(denied)]):
            result = invoke([*prefix, "validate", "fixtures/v1.json"])
            assert result.returncode == 1 and not result.stdout and result.stderr
            output.write_bytes(b"original")
            result = invoke([*prefix, "migrate", "-", "--output", str(output)], input=source)
            assert result.returncode == 1 and output.read_bytes() == b"original"
        assert (ROOT / "fixtures/v1.json").read_bytes() == source
        report_path = build / f"process-acceptance-harness-v1-{time.time_ns()}.json"
        report_path.write_text(json.dumps({"schema": "marimay-config.process-acceptance/1",
            "harness": harness_metadata, "exact_parity_cases": len(cases),
            "additional_checks": ["atomic", "denied", "broken-pipe"],
            "elapsed_seconds": time.monotonic() - start}, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2) + "\n")
        print(f"report: {report_path}")
        print(f"acceptance: {len(cases)} exact-parity cases × 3 engines; atomic/denied/broken-pipe checks passed")
        print(f"elapsed: {time.monotonic() - start:.2f}s (correctness run, not a latency baseline)")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Real POSIX filesystem acceptance; no application logic or mocked host calls."""
import hashlib
import json
import os
from pathlib import Path
import platform
import stat
import tempfile
import time

from acceptance import HARNESS, MMAY, ROOT


def main():
    if os.name != "posix" or os.geteuid() == 0:
        raise SystemExit("This acceptance requires an unprivileged POSIX account")
    started = time.monotonic()
    source = (ROOT / "fixtures/v1.json").read_bytes()
    expected = (ROOT / "fixtures/v2.json").read_bytes().removesuffix(b"\n")
    records = []
    # Keep denied data outside the source discovery tree. Resolve macOS /var
    # to its physical spelling so the fixture itself has no ambient symlink.
    with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix="marimay-config-files-") as temporary:
        work = Path(temporary).resolve()
        allowed = work / "разрешено с пробелами"
        outside = work / "outside"
        allowed.mkdir()
        outside.mkdir()
        original = allowed / "исходник.json"
        original.write_bytes(source)
        outsider = outside / "outside.json"
        outsider.write_bytes(source)
        grants = ["--allow-read", str(allowed), "--allow-write", str(allowed)]
        engines = HARNESS.engines(work, "config", grants)
        harness_metadata = HARNESS.metadata(engines)

        def compare(name, arguments, status, *, data=None, prepare=lambda: None,
                    verify=lambda: None):
            def verify_case(engine, result):
                actual = (result.returncode, result.stdout, result.stderr)
                assert not (result.stderr if status == 0 else result.stdout), (name, engine, actual)
                payload = result.stdout if status == 0 else result.stderr
                try:
                    report = json.loads(payload)
                except json.JSONDecodeError as error:
                    raise AssertionError((name, engine, actual)) from error
                assert report["ok"] == (status == 0) and report["location"] == "$", (name, report)
                verify()
            reference = HARNESS.compare(engines, [*arguments, "--json"], status,
                data=data, label=name, prepare=prepare, verify=verify_case)
            records.append({"name": name, "exit": status,
                "stdout": reference[1].decode(), "stderr": reference[2].decode()})

        def unchanged():
            assert original.read_bytes() == source and outsider.read_bytes() == source
            assert not list(allowed.rglob("*.mmay-tmp-*"))

        compare("unicode-space-path", ["validate", str(original)], 0, verify=unchanged)
        # Every denied path is lexically inside the granted root. Targets may be
        # inside or outside it; the existing D077 contract rejects links in both.
        links = {
            "relative-file": (Path(original.name), False),
            "outside-file": (outsider, False),
            "dangling-file": (Path("missing-target.json"), False),
        }
        for name, (target, directory) in links.items():
            link = allowed / (name + ".json")
            link.symlink_to(target, target_is_directory=directory)
            def intact(link=link, target=target):
                unchanged()
                assert link.is_symlink() and os.readlink(link) == str(target)
                assert not (allowed / "missing-target.json").exists()
            compare(name + "-read", ["validate", str(link)], 1, verify=intact)
            compare(name + "-write", ["migrate", "-", "--output", str(link)],
                1, data=source, verify=intact)
            compare(name + "-in-place", ["migrate", str(link), "--in-place"],
                1, verify=intact)
        real_dir = allowed / "real-directory"
        real_dir.mkdir()
        (real_dir / "input.json").write_bytes(source)
        for name, target, filename in (("inside-parent", real_dir, "input.json"),
                ("outside-parent", outside, "outside.json")):
            link = allowed / name
            link.symlink_to(target, target_is_directory=True)
            def parent_intact(link=link):
                unchanged()
                assert link.is_symlink()
                assert (real_dir / "input.json").read_bytes() == source
            compare(name + "-read", ["validate", str(link / filename)], 1, verify=parent_intact)
            compare(name + "-write", ["migrate", "-", "--output", str(link / filename)],
                1, data=source, verify=parent_intact)
        compare("directory-read", ["validate", str(real_dir)], 1, verify=unchanged)
        compare("directory-write", ["migrate", "-", "--output", str(real_dir)],
            1, data=source, verify=unchanged)
        fifo = allowed / "fifo"
        os.mkfifo(fifo, 0o600)
        compare("fifo-read", ["validate", str(fifo)], 1, verify=unchanged)
        compare("fifo-write", ["migrate", "-", "--output", str(fifo)],
            1, data=source, verify=unchanged)
        assert stat.S_ISFIFO(fifo.lstat().st_mode)

        unreadable = allowed / "unreadable.json"
        unreadable.write_bytes(source)
        unreadable.chmod(0)
        try:
            try:
                unreadable.read_bytes()
            except PermissionError:
                pass
            else:
                raise AssertionError("OS did not enforce read denial")
            compare("os-read-denied", ["validate", str(unreadable)], 1)
        finally:
            unreadable.chmod(0o600)
        assert unreadable.read_bytes() == source
        blocked = allowed / "unsearchable"
        blocked.mkdir()
        hidden = blocked / "input.json"
        hidden.write_bytes(source)
        blocked.chmod(0o600)
        try:
            try:
                hidden.stat()
            except PermissionError:
                pass
            else:
                raise AssertionError("OS did not enforce directory search denial")
            compare("os-search-denied", ["validate", str(hidden)], 1)
        finally:
            blocked.chmod(0o700)
        assert hidden.read_bytes() == source
        readonly = allowed / "unwritable"
        readonly.mkdir()
        retained = readonly / "existing.json"
        retained.write_bytes(b"original")
        readonly.chmod(0o500)
        try:
            try:
                (readonly / "probe").write_bytes(b"probe")
            except PermissionError:
                pass
            else:
                raise AssertionError("OS did not enforce directory write denial")
            def retained_intact():
                assert retained.read_bytes() == b"original"
                assert sorted(p.name for p in readonly.iterdir()) == ["existing.json"]
            for name in ("existing.json", "new.json"):
                compare("os-write-denied-" + name,
                    ["migrate", "-", "--output", str(readonly / name)],
                    1, data=source, verify=retained_intact)
        finally:
            readonly.chmod(0o700)
        output = allowed / "normal-output.json"
        def migrated():
            unchanged()
            assert output.read_bytes() == expected
        compare("atomic-replace-success", ["migrate", "-", "--output", str(output)],
            0, data=source, prepare=lambda: output.write_bytes(b"original"), verify=migrated)
        unchanged()
    result = {"schema": "marimay-config.files-acceptance/1", "platform": platform.platform(),
        "harness": harness_metadata,
        "uid": os.geteuid(), "compiler_sha256": hashlib.sha256(Path(MMAY).read_bytes()).hexdigest(),
        "elapsed_seconds": time.monotonic() - started, "engines": list(engines), "cases": records,
        "scope": "static symlink cases and real POSIX permissions; no concurrent namespace-race claim"}
    report_path = ROOT / "build" / f"files-acceptance-harness-v1-{time.time_ns()}.json"
    report_path.write_text(
        json.dumps(result, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2) + "\n")
    print(f"report: {report_path}")
    print(f"filesystem acceptance: {len(records)} exact-parity cases × 3 engines; real OS denials and static symlinks passed")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Sequential, reproducible CLI workload measurements; no application logic."""
import argparse
import datetime
import hashlib
import json
import os
from pathlib import Path
import platform
import re
import shutil
import statistics
import subprocess
import tempfile
import time

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
LANGUAGE = ROOT.parent.parent / "marimay"


def run(arguments, *, data=None, timeout=60):
    start = time.perf_counter()
    try:
        result = subprocess.run(arguments, cwd=ROOT, input=data, capture_output=True, timeout=timeout)
    except subprocess.TimeoutExpired:
        return {"seconds": time.perf_counter() - start, "timeout": timeout}
    return {
        "seconds": time.perf_counter() - start,
        "status": result.returncode,
        "stdout": result.stdout.decode("utf-8", errors="replace"),
        "stderr": result.stderr.decode("utf-8", errors="replace"),
    }


def dataset(count, version_last=False):
    value = {
        "version": 2,
        "project": {"name": "Проект 🌿", "root": "."},
        "scan": {"extensions": [".my", ".json"], "maxFileBytes": 1024,
                 "requiredFiles": [f"sources/file-{i:05d}.my" for i in range(count)]},
    }
    if version_last:
        value["version"] = value.pop("version")
    return json.dumps(value, ensure_ascii=False, separators=(",", ":")).encode()


def record(report, name, arguments, data, samples):
    results = [run(arguments, data=data) for _ in range(samples)]
    for item in results:
        item["ok"] = item.get("status") == 0 and not item.get("stderr")
        if item["ok"] and data is not None:
            item["ok"] = item["stdout"] == '{"ok":true,"message":"Конфиг корректен.","location":"$"}'
        elif item["ok"]:
            item["ok"] = "7 passed; 0 failed" in item["stdout"]
    successful = [item["seconds"] for item in results if item["ok"]]
    report["measurements"][name] = {
        "command": arguments,
        "input_bytes": len(data) if data is not None else None,
        "input_sha256": hashlib.sha256(data).hexdigest() if data is not None else None,
        "samples": results,
        "median_seconds": statistics.median(successful) if successful else None,
        "all_passed": all(item["ok"] for item in results),
    }
    print(name, json.dumps({"seconds": [round(item["seconds"], 4) for item in results],
                           "all_passed": all(item["ok"] for item in results)}), flush=True)


def main():
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser()
    parser.add_argument("--output", type=Path, required=True)
    args = parser.parse_args()
    if args.output.exists():
        raise SystemExit("Выходной отчёт уже существует; выберите новое имя.")
    mmay = shutil.which(os.environ.get("MMAY", "mmay"))
    if mmay is None:
        raise SystemExit("mmay не найден")
    language_revision = subprocess.check_output(["git", "-C", str(LANGUAGE), "rev-parse", "HEAD"], text=True).strip()
    language_dirty = subprocess.check_output(["git", "-C", str(LANGUAGE), "status", "--porcelain"], text=True)
    sources = [ROOT / "mmay.mod", *sorted(ROOT.rglob("*.my"))]
    source_hashes = {str(file.relative_to(ROOT)): hashlib.sha256(file.read_bytes()).hexdigest()
                     for file in sources if "build" not in file.relative_to(ROOT).parts}
    report = {
        "schema": "marimay-config.measurements/1",
        "started_utc": datetime.datetime.now(datetime.timezone.utc).isoformat(),
        "host": platform.platform(),
        "cpu": subprocess.check_output(["sysctl", "-n", "machdep.cpu.brand_string"], text=True).strip()
               if platform.system() == "Darwin" else platform.machine(),
        "language_revision": language_revision, "language_dirty": bool(language_dirty),
        "compiler": mmay, "compiler_sha256": hashlib.sha256(Path(mmay).read_bytes()).hexdigest(),
        "compiler_doctor": run([mmay, "doctor"]),
        "application_source_sha256": source_hashes,
        "conditions": "Sequential fresh processes. No deliberate OS cache eviction. First measured run is not a disk-cold claim. Normal desktop background applications remain running; no fully idle-host claim.",
        "budgets": {"run_first_seconds": 1, "run_repeat_seconds": 0.3,
                    "native_small_seconds": 0.1, "test_both_seconds": 10,
                    "vm_near_limit_seconds": 10, "native_near_limit_seconds": 1,
                    "peak_rss_bytes": 268435456},
        "measurements": {},
    }
    vm = [mmay, "run", ".", "--", "validate", "-", "--json"]
    small = dataset(0)
    record(report, "run_first", vm, small, 1)
    record(report, "run_repeat", vm, small, 7)
    build = ROOT / "build"
    build.mkdir(exist_ok=True)
    with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix="measure-", dir=build) as directory:
        binary = Path(directory) / "marimay-config"
        report["native_build"] = run([mmay, "build", ".", "--release", "--output", str(binary)])
        assert report["native_build"].get("status") == 0, report["native_build"]
        native = [str(binary), "validate", "-", "--json"]
        record(report, "native_small", native, small, 7)
        for name, contents in (("medium", dataset(1000)),
                               ("near_limit_first", dataset(43680)),
                               ("near_limit_last", dataset(43680, True))):
            assert len(contents) <= 1048576
            record(report, "vm_" + name, vm, contents, 1)
            record(report, "native_" + name, native, contents, 1)
        record(report, "test_both", [mmay, "test", ".", "--engine", "both"], None, 3)
        contents = dataset(43680)
        for name, command in (("vm", vm), ("native", native)):
            flags = ["-l"] if platform.system() == "Darwin" else ["-v"]
            result = run(["/usr/bin/time", *flags, *command], data=contents)
            result["output_matches"] = result.get("stdout") == '{"ok":true,"message":"Конфиг корректен.","location":"$"}'
            pattern = r"(\d+)\s+maximum resident set size" if platform.system() == "Darwin" else r"Maximum resident set size \(kbytes\): (\d+)"
            match = re.search(pattern, result.get("stderr", ""))
            result["peak_rss_bytes"] = int(match.group(1)) * (1 if platform.system() == "Darwin" else 1024) if match else None
            report["measurements"][name + "_near_limit_rss"] = result
            print(name + "_near_limit_rss", result["peak_rss_bytes"], flush=True)
    args.output.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    args.output.write_text(json.dumps(report, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2) + "\n")
